title: Graph Atlas
subtitle: Top-down entry point — pick a tile to drill in, a leaf to open it in the Graph Explorer.
headerButton_hint: Open the Graph Atlas — the top-down overview of the whole solution.

weight.label: Weighting
weight.domain_hint: Domain weight (ClusterEdges) — builtins and god-nodes already removed.
weight.logical_hint: Raw logical degree — includes builtin functions.

topN.label: Top-N
topN.hint: How many top segments/leaves to show before the rest is folded into one tile.

status.clustersMissing: Not clustered yet — run “fm-graph-cluster” to enable Community & Topology.

truncated: Showing the top entries — the rest is collected in the grey tile.

hint.leafClick: Tip: click a leaf tile to open that object in the Graph Explorer.
hint.metaClick: Tip: click a super-node to open its heaviest member in the Graph Explorer.

hidden.dim_hint: Hidden nodes stay visible (dimmed) and remain reversible.
hidden.hide_hint: Hidden nodes are removed — undo only via the list.
hidden.manage_hint: List of all hidden nodes — restore them here.

color.label: Colour
color.type_hint: Colour the tiles by object type.
color.recency_hint: Colour the tiles by the age of their newest individual change — mass events never count as young.
color.saves_hint: Colour the tiles by the lifetime save counter of their members (rank within the object type) — robust against mass events.
color.unavailable: This catalog carries no change stamps — import the solution again to colour by activity.
color.bulk_hint: Include mass events: a mass stamp then dates the last change like an individual one.

activity.unknownHint: For {{pct}} % of the nodes the age of the last real change is unknown — a young mass event overwrote their stamps. The lifetime saves separate the modules here.

tooltip.newest: Newest change: {{date}} ({{days}} days before the data state)
